title: Alqosh, Lalish & Newroz at Akre
full_text:
Explore the Christian village of Alqosh, home to the Rabban Hormizd Monastery and the Tomb of the Jewish prophet, Nahum.
Then head to Lalish, and discover the sacred Yezidi temple and learn about their culture.
Head to Akre, and witness the Nowruz celebrations and the famous fire ceremony.
An option to join celebratory walks with the locals.
Head to Duhok.
